content: Jesos omikodan patado8ini
Jesos ogi inan okikinoamaganan: “Apanigotc kada 8ikobinagani8i8ag a8iagog kidji patadi8adj. Kada madji iji8ebizi dac a8iag ka 8ik8adjiadjin kodagian kidji patadindjin.

Na8adj kada minoseban aa a8iag kidji acodapinagani8indjin kitci asinin og8ei8akag, acitc kidji pakobi8ebinagani8idj kitcigamikag, apitc8in pejig a8ian ka agacinojanig oteb8etamo8ini kidji 8ik8adjiadjin kidji patadindjin.
Iag8amenimidizok dac!” “Kicpin kidjiki8e patadidj, 8idamao 8e8enda. Kicpin dac an8endizodj, mi iji ponenim ka iji patadidj.
Kicpin madji todaok nij8atcinanaj pejigokajik, acitc tasinanaj ikidodj: ‘Nikackendan egi madji todaonan,’ mi iji ponenim.”
Jesos omikodan teb8etamo8ini
Ka Tibendjigedj Odanodaganan ogi igon: “Micaton niteb8etamo8ininan.”

Ka Tibendjigedj dac ogi nak8e8ajian: “Kicpin anomin ka iniginidj inigok8agiban kiteb8etamo8ini8a, kida kackitona8a kidji ineg aa8e mitig: ‘8ik8adabigitan, acitc a8i padakicimidizon kitcigamikag,’ kida ndotago8a dac.”
Enendagozidj anokitage8inni kidji ijitcigedj

“8adan oo8e. Pejig e tacieg odaia8an anokitage8innin e kitigendjin kitigan akikag koni e kana8enimandjin a8esizan. Apitc dac kitigan akikag odosendjin ini anokitage8innin, ka8in oga inasin: ‘Teci8ag pi nda 8isin!’
Tiegodj oga inan: ‘Ojitamaocin kidji 8isinian. Adjikonaen kidji anokitaojian pinici nin kidji ick8a 8isinian acitc kidji ick8a minik8eian. Midac ick8ataian kigagi 8isin acitc kigagi minik8e kintam.’
Ka8in mamakadj mig8etc oga inasin odanokitage8inniman adi ka inanonadjin.
Mi maia pejig8an kekina8a, apitc ick8ataieg kakina ka inanonigo8eg kida ikidom: ‘Nimotci anokitage8inni8imin. Nigi motci ijitamin ka inendagoziag kidji ijitaiag.’ ”
Jesos okigean midatcin a8iagon ka kitci omigi8apinendjin
Meg8adj dac Jesos e pimi ijagobanen Jerusalemikag, ki ani nasa8icka Samani (Samarie) akini acitc Galilee akini.
Apitc pejig odenajicikag ka ani pidigedj, midatcin a8iagon ka kitci omigi8apinendjin ogi pi nazikagon, kitci kotadendag8anoban ako ii inapine8in. Ka8in dac ododji pec8abamasi8a8an Jesosan.
Ki kitci madji pabibagi8ag dac: “Jesos, ka Tibeniminak! Kidimagenimicinam!”
Apitc Jesos ka 8abamadjin ogi inan: “A8i 8abadaikog Coda8inni aiamie ogimag adi e ijinagozieg.” Meg8adj dac e ani ija8apan, ki kige8ag.
Pejig dac e taci8adj, apitc e kikendag egi kigegobanen, ogi koki nda 8abaman Jesosan, e kitci kiji8edj e icpenimadjin Kije Manidon.
Ki nibak8i dac acitc ki onijik8ebanio akikag, mig8etc e inadjin. Aa dac nabe Samani aki odjigoban.
Jesos dac ki ikido: “Kakina midatcin e taci8adj ki kige8ag, kana? Adi dac apan kodagiag cagidatcin?
Kana kodag a8iag ogi inendasin kidji koki pijadj, mig8etc kidji inadjin Kije Manidon, mi na eta aa8e ega ka Coda8inni8idj?”
Midac Jesos ogi inan ini a8ian: “Pazig8in, mi iji madjan. Kiteb8etamo8in kigi kigeigon.”
Jesos omikodan Kije Manidon Odogima8i8ini

Nigodin Coda8innig ka nagadjito8agobanen inakonige8inan ogi k8ag8edjima8an Jesosan: “Anapitc ke 8abadamag Kije Manido Odogima8i8in?” Ogi nak8e8ajian dac: “Ka8in kadagi 8abadjigadesinon Kije Manido Odogima8i8in apitc pijamagag.
Ka8in kada ikidonani8asinon: ‘Kana8abadamok! Aja tag8icinomagan ooma!’ kek8an: ‘Aja tag8icinomagan 8edi!’ Kije Manido mega aja ogima8i kina8akag.”
Ogi inan dac okikinoamaganan: “Kada ijise kidji kitci 8i 8abameg Aa8e Ka pi Anicinabe8iidizodj, misa8adj pejigokajik eta 8abamegoban. Ka8in dac kada minosesinon kidji 8abameg.
Kada ikidonani8an: ‘8edi te!’ kek8an: ‘Mi ooma e tedj!’ Ka8in dac 8edi ijakegon kidji nda 8abameg.
Mi maia tabickotc ka kitci 8asakoneseg, mizi8e dac 8ak8ig ka 8asakonemagag, mi ke ijinag8anig apitc pi tag8icig Ka pi Anicinabe8iidizodj.
Panima dac ki kitci kodagitodj pinama, acitc panima ki 8ebinigodjin a8iagon nogom ka pimadizindjin.”
“Kagi iji8ebag meg8adj No8a (Noé) ka tepan, mi maia pejig8an ke iji8ebag apitc tag8icig Aa8e Ka pi Anicinabe8iidizodj.

Ii apitc, a8iagog 8isini8agoban acitc minik8e8agoban, acitc nabeg acitc ik8e8ag niba8i8agoban, pinici No8a kidji pidigedj kitci tcimanikag. Ii apitc ki kitci kimi8an pinici kidji kitci nikibinig, acitc kakina igi8e a8iagog ki nisaba8e8ag.”
“Mi pejig8an ka iji8ebag apitc Lot ka pimadizipan. A8iagog 8isini8agoban acitc minik8e8agoban. Odapinige8agoban acitc ada8e8agoban. Kitige8agoban acitc migi8amike8agoban.
Apitc dac Lot ka nagadamogobanen Sodom odenani, ki papagisin ickode ka kitci oza8abateg acitc ka kitci kotazomateg akikag, midac kakina ki nici8anadjio8ag.”
“Mi maia pejig8an ke iji8ebag apitc pi nagozidj Aa8e Ka pi Anicinabe8iidizodj.”
“Ii kijigag aa8edi 8agidabak8an omigi8amikag ke teg8en, ka8in kadagi pidigebatosi kidji a8i nda 8abadagin odaiman. Mi pejig8an, aa8e okitigan akikag ke teg8en, ka8in kadagi koki ki8esi.
Mik8enimik ka ijisendjin Lot okokomiman.
Aa8e ka 8i kana8endag opimadizi8in kada nibo, aa8e dac pekic ke nibog8en, oga pimadjiton opimadizi8in.
Ki8idamonom, meg8adj ii e tibikag, kada nijog8amo8ag a8iagog. Pejig dac kada madji8inagani8i, kodag dac kada naganagani8i.
Nijin ik8e8ag ma8asag kada tcibak8e8ag. Pejig dac kada madji8inagani8i, kodag dac kada naganagani8i.
[Nijin nabeg kitigan akikag kada mikimo8ag tabickotc. Pejig dac kada madji8inagani8i, kodag dac kada naganagani8i.]”

Jesos dac okikinoamaganan ogi k8ag8edjimigon: “Tebendjigean! Ataji dac ii ke iji iji8ebag?” Jesos dac ogi nak8e8ajian: “Taji ke iji tanatenig8en o8ia8 a8esiz kagi nibodj, mi iima ke iji ma8adjiidi8adj kakagig.”
